card.name: Second part of compound terms
card.fires_on: The second piece of a two-part term, right after a word that expects a partner, such as steady-state, meal-time, or Digoxin Oral. Mostly in drug-label text.

modes.label: Steady-state
modes.description: The word state after 'steady' in pharmacokinetic phrases.

modes.label: Other compound endings
modes.description: The ending of a compound or noun phrase such as mealtime, passenger routes or Oral Solution.
modes.example: reduce meal<<time>> insulin doses, including premixed insul

modes.label: Titles and split words
modes.description: The next piece in a book title or a split-up capitalised word.
modes.example: IN PAT<<IENT>>S WHO HAVE HAD AN UNSAT

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mixed and mostly non-English.
card.plain: It lights up on the second half of a two-part term, like the 'state' in steady-state.
